---
title: "Group summary report"
---

- File: `r params$file_name`
- Numeric column: `r params$value_col`
- Grouping column: `r params$group_col`
- Generated: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`

## Summary per group

n counts non-missing values; missing values are excluded from mean and sd.

```{r, echo = FALSE}
knitr::kable(params$table, digits = 2)
```

## Boxplot

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
print(params$plot)
```
